description: This Java class implements a strategy for handling the 'ModifyPolicyId' command in the Eclipse Ditto project. It determines whether to modify an existing policy ID or create a new one based on the current state of a Thing entity, and generates corresponding event and response objects.

classes.name: ModifyPolicyIdStrategy
classes.description: A class that handles the 'ModifyPolicyId' command, performing either an update of an existing policy ID or creating a new one, and generating related events and responses.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the strategy logic, deciding whether to modify or create a policy ID based on the current state.

methods.name: extractPolicyId
methods.description: Retrieves the PolicyId from the given Thing, if present.

methods.name: getModifyResult
methods.description: Constructs a Result object for modifying an existing policy ID, including generating the corresponding event and response.

methods.name: getCreateResult
methods.description: Constructs a Result object for creating a new policy ID, including generating the corresponding event and response.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the EntityTag of the previous entity state, if available.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the EntityTag for the new entity state, based on the command.
